source.title: Artificial Intelligence in Gallbladder Carcinoma: A Review of Research Studies and Clinical Evidence.
source.excerpt: AI could plausibly assist several steps of GBC care, but the evidence is dominated by retrospective, single-center, internally validated studies from Asia, and metrics from different studies are not directly comparable. Prospective multicenter external validation, shared annotated datasets and standardized reporting are required before clinical adoption.

source.title: U-Bahn-Strecke B (Frankfurt am Main)
source.excerpt: Die U-Bahn-Strecke B oder B-Strecke ist die zweite Strecke im Netz der U-Bahn Frankfurt. Sie führt in Ost-West-Richtung vom Hauptbahnhof über die Altstadt zur Konstablerwache, wo sie sich in zwei Äste nach Bornheim und Preungesheim aufspaltet. Die ursprünglich als eigenständige Grundstrecke geplante D-Strecke stellt ab dem Hauptbahnhof eine Verlängerung der U4 zur Bockenheimer Warte dar.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in pediatric allergic diseases: what the clinician needs to know

source.title: Artificial intelligence in pediatric allergic diseases: what the clinician needs to know.
source.excerpt: AI is closer to the bedside in pediatric allergy than in many other areas of pediatrics, but few tools are ready for autonomous clinical use. No trial has yet shown that acting on an AI-derived risk estimate improves clinical outcomes in children.

cards.headline: Bone morphogenetic protein 4 meets artificial intelligence

source.title: Bone morphogenetic protein 4 meets artificial intelligence: a comprehensive review of AI-driven advances in drug discovery, structural modeling, and clinical translation.
source.excerpt: The convergence of BMP4 biology and AI represents a fertile research Frontier. While foundational tools are now in place, realizing the full translational potential of AI-augmented BMP4 research will require coordinated efforts in data generation, model development, and rigorous experimental and clinical validation. We outline priority directions for the next 5 years (approximately 2026-2031).

source.title: Henry Morton Stanley

cards.headline: Dahinschwinden lassen wird Allah den Zins und vermehren die Almosen.

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:276
source.excerpt: يذهب الله الربا كله أو يحرم صاحبه بركة ماله، فلا ينتفع به، وينمي الصدقات ويكثرها، ويضاعف الأجر للمتصدقين، ويبارك لهم في أموالهم. والله لا يحب كل مُصِرٍّ على كفره، مُسْتَحِلٍّ أكل الربا، متمادٍ في الإثم والحرام ومعاصي الله.

cards.arabic: يَمْحَقُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ وَيُرْبِى ٱلصَّدَقَـٰتِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ أَثِيمٍ
cards.translation: Dahinschwinden lassen wird Allah den Zins und vermehren die Almosen. Allah liebt niemanden, der ein beharrlicher Ungläubiger und Sünder ist.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: Allah Does Not Bless Riba: Allah states that He destroys Riba, either by removing this money from those who eat it, or by depriving them of the blessing, and thus the benefit of their money.

cards.headline: Gewiß, diejenigen, die glauben und rechtschaffene Werke tun …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:277
source.excerpt: إن الذين صدقوا الله ورسوله، وعملوا الأعمال الطيبة، وأدَّوا الصلاة كما أمر الله ورسوله، وأخرجوا زكاة أموالهم، لهم ثواب عظيم خاص بهم عند ربهم ورازقهم، ولا يلحقهم خوف في آخرتهم، ولا حزن على ما فاتهم من حظوظ دنياهم.

cards.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
cards.translation: Gewiß, diejenigen, die glauben und rechtschaffene Werke tun, das Gebet verrichten und die Abgabe entrichten, die haben ihren Lohn bei ihrem Herrn, und keine Furcht soll sie überkommen, noch werden sie traurig sein.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: Allah Does Not Bless Riba: Allah states that He destroys Riba, either by removing this money from those who eat it, or by depriving them of the blessing, and thus the benefit of their money.
